Still looking great! Here's the updated status and a refresher on my capabilities:

---

## 📊 Current Context Status

```xml
<context_status>
  <tokens_used>339</tokens_used>
  <total_capacity>200,000</total_capacity>
  <utilization>0.17%</utilization>
  <zone>OPTIMAL ✅</zone>
  <recommendation>Context is healthy. No action needed.</recommendation>
</context_status>
```

> 📈 **Note:** We've grown slightly from **0.01% → 0.17%** as our conversation has accumulated, but we're still well within the safe zone.

---

## 🧠 My Context Management Capabilities

I follow **Horthy's 40% Rule** — once utilization exceeds 40%, performance degrades (the "Dumb Zone"), so I act *proactively* to keep things lean.

### 🔧 Tools at My Disposal

| Tool | Function | Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| `check_context_budget` | Monitor utilization & zone status | Regularly & before complex tasks |
| `compress_history` | Rolling summarization (recent = verbatim, old = summarized) | Utilization nearing 40% |
| `hierarchical_compress` | Tiered compression by message age | Heavy-duty / long conversations |
| `retrieve_relevant` | Smart memory search within a token budget | Recalling specific past context |

---

### 🗂️ Compression Strategies

#### 1. `compress_history` — Rolling Summarization
Older messages → **summarized**, recent messages → **kept verbatim**. Simple and effective for most conversations.

#### 2. `hierarchical_compress` — Three-Tier Age-Based Compression
```xml
<compression_tiers>
  <tier age="recent" turns="less than 10">Kept verbatim</tier>
  <tier age="medium" turns="10 to 30">Paragraph summaries</tier>
  <tier age="old" turns="more than 30">Key facts only</tier>
</compression_tiers>
```

#### 3. `retrieve_relevant` — Targeted Memory Retrieval
Rather than loading everything, I can **search** past context like a database — pulling only the most relevant, highest-scoring pieces within a set token limit.

---

### ⚙️ My Operating Workflow

```xml
<workflow>
  <step order="1">Check context budget at start of complex tasks</step>
  <step order="2">Compress proactively before hitting 40%</step>
  <step order="3">Retrieve only what's needed for memory-heavy tasks</step>
  <step order="4">Prefer XML for structured data output</step>
</workflow>
```

At **0.17% utilization**, we have enormous headroom — roughly **199,661 tokens** still available. Fire away! 🚀
